title: Hourglass with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Top frame -->
  <rect x="22" y="8" width="56" height="8" rx="4" fill="#FFB347"/>
  <!-- Bottom frame -->
  <rect x="22" y="84" width="56" height="8" rx="4" fill="#FFB347"/>
  <!-- Glass body - top bulb -->
  <path d="M30 16 Q30 45 45 50 Q30 55 30 84 L70 84 Q70 55 55 50 Q70 45 70 16 Z" fill="#88D8F7" opacity="0.55"/>
  <!-- Top sand -->
  <path d="M35 20 L65 20 Q65 38 50 46 Q35 38 35 20 Z" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <!-- Falling sand stream -->
  <rect x="48" y="46" width="4" height="10" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <!-- Bottom sand pile -->
  <path d="M35 80 Q50 60 65 80 Z" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <!-- Sand sparkle particles -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="55" r="1.2" fill="#FFF3A0"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="62" r="1.2" fill="#FFF3A0"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="72" r="1.2" fill="#FFF3A0"/>
  <!-- Face - eyes -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="34" r="3.5" fill="#2A2A4A"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="34" r="3.5" fill="#2A2A4A"/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx="42.5" cy="32.5" r="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="60.5" cy="32.5" r="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M40 40 Q50 50 60 40" stroke="#2A2A4A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="40" r="3" fill="#FF9999" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="40" r="3" fill="#FF9999" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Glass shine highlights -->
  <path d="M35 22 Q37 30 36 38" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M64 62 Q64 70 64 76" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
